name: Standalone Upstream-Compatible Dynamic Grouped FP8 GEMM Portable CUDA From-Zero Lab v3

work.agent_query:
Read AGENT_TASK.md and README_AGENT.md before changing code. From the empty Triton submission, implement both complete grouped FP8 GEMM entry points for the masked and prefix-sum tensor contracts, correct and memory-safe over the whole declared support domain (any per-group row count including empty groups, 1-64 groups, 128-aligned N and K from 128 to 8192, and a hint that is scheduling information only), then optimize across the prefill, decode, latency and sequence workload families. Your score comes from many hidden test cases on the Judge that model MoE serving workloads and use different shapes and larger batches than the public tests. Your final result is the best valid score you reach within the time budget, so keep versioned candidates and leave FINAL_VERSION on your strongest clean candidate. Check candidates with the public edge and sanitizer suites (tools/run_public_tests.sh --edge or --sanitize with --candidate-version N) before submitting, and before finishing run the full public suite, the edge suite and the sanitizer suite once on the selected version:

```bash
tools/run_public_tests.sh --candidate-version N
tools/run_public_tests.sh --edge --candidate-version N
tools/run_public_tests.sh --sanitize --candidate-version N
```

Evaluate candidates only by the feedback from the public tests and your submissions; do not copy external implementations or solution material into your submission, and Judge internals are unavailable. Before each manual submission, wait for all public-test and compiler workers to exit, then run sforge-submit --details; each Judge run uses part of your budget.

invariants: fp32 accumulation of a_scale*b_scale scaled 128-block partial products, cast once to bf16

support domain: 1<=G<=64, 128-aligned 128<=N,K<=8192, 128-aligned 128<=M_max<=4096 (masked) or <=131072 (prefix-sum) with G*M_max*(K+2N)<=2^34, any 0<=M_g<=M_max, expected_m_hint is scheduling information only
masked: only rows m < m_sizes[g] are required; psum: group g starts at align(group_ends[g-1], 128) and ends at group_ends[g]
every non-empty group: normalized error against the fp64 dequantized-fp8 product below 5e-5; upstream calc_diff against the bf16 source gemm below 1e-3 on slices of at least 16384 outputs
the output is fully written on the current stream, nothing outside out is written and every input is unchanged
only torch metadata/dispatch and triton source; no existing GEMM kernel, compiled extension, private stream, graph, replay, patching or seed specialisation

spec.effective_flops: 2*sum(dynamic_group_rows)*N*K summed over the calls of a trial or round
